Title: CyrenaCoreComponent
Summary: Developer documentation page for the Cyrena.Core NuGet package. Displays contracts, models, options, and extension methods.
Content:
**File:** `src/app/features/developer/components/cyrena-core/cyrena-core.component.ts`

**Selector:** `app-cyrena-core`

**Route:** `/developer/core`

**Purpose:** Comprehensive documentation page for the `Cyrena.Core` NuGet package — the foundational class library of the Cyréna AI assistant framework. Defines all core contracts, data models, application builders, and extension methods that the rest of the solution depends on.

**Sections:**
1. **Overview** — Package description, namespace (`Cyrena`), target framework (.NET 10.0), core dependency (`Microsoft.SemanticKernel`)
2. **Contracts** — All core interfaces:
   - `IAssistantMode` — Configures kernel behavior for a specific assistant mode. Has `AssistantModeDefault` const, `ConfigureAsync`, `DeleteAsync`, `EditAsync`
   - `IAssistantPlugin` — Adds services/features to an `IAssistantMode`. Has `Modes` (empty = all), `Priority`, `Required`, `Title`
   - `IChatMessageService` (Kernel-locked) — Dual history model (kernel + display). Events: `OnStreamToken`, `OnDisplayHistoryChanged`, `OnKernelHistoryChanged`, `OnHistoryLoaded`
   - `IChatConfigurationService` — Persistent chat configuration access
   - `IConnection` (Kernel-locked) — LLM provider adapter. `HandleAsync(ChatMessageContent, ct)`, `FunctionCallStart()`
   - `IConnectionProvider` — Manages LLM connections. `ListConnectionsAsync`, `HasConnectionAsync`, `AttachAsync`
   - `IConversationHistoryTransformer` (Kernel-locked) — History modification with base class `ConversationHistoryTransformer`
   - `ICyrenaFileExporter` (Kernel-locked) — Exports `.cyrena` zipped archives with manifest
   - `ICyrenaFileImporter` (Global service) — Processes imported `.cyrena` files. Must be registered as global singleton
   - `IFileHandler` (Kernel-locked) — File attachment handling with `GetKernelContent(byte[], ...)`
   - `IFileHandlerFactory` (Kernel-locked) — Aggregated access to all `IFileHandler` instances. Manages file attachments persistence with `SaveAsync`, `CreateAsync`, `UpdateAsync`, `DeleteFileAttachmentAsync`, `ListAttachmentsAsync`, `GetAttachmentAsync`
   - `IKernelController` — Kernel lifecycle management. `ActiveKernels`, `LoadAsync`, `Create`, `UpdateAsync`, `Unload`, `GetKernel`, `KernelActive`. Events: `OnChatDelete`, `OnChatCreate`, `OnChatUpdate`, `OnChatUnload`, `OnChatLoadStart`, `OnChatLoaded`, `OnChatLoadError`
   - `IKernelResolver` (Kernel-locked) — Provides access to current kernel via `Func<Kernel> Resolve`
   - `IPromptManager` (Kernel-locked) — Dynamic prompts with `AddPrompt`, `UpdatePrompt`, `RemovePrompt`
   - `IIterationService` (Kernel-locked) — Chat iteration with `Ulid? IterationId`, `IsPaused`, `QueueCount`, `IsPausedByAi`, `Queued`. Methods: `Iterate()`, `Cancel()`, `PauseQueue(bool by_ai)`, `ContinueQueue()`, `CancelInput(string id)`
   - `ISettingsService` — Encrypted settings storage
   - `IFileDialog` — Cross-platform file dialogs including `SelectFolder`
   - `IStartupTask` — Ordered post-DI startup tasks
3. **Models** — Data models:
   - `ChatConfiguration` (extends Entity) — With `FileStoragePath`, `HistoryInclusion` (defaults to `HistoryInclusionMode.All`), `[Required] ConnectionId`
   - `ChatMessageContentEntity` (extends Entity) — Persisted chat history with `IterationId`, `ModelId`, `Metadata`, `MimeType`, `Items` (List<KernelContentEntity>). `AsChatMessage()` method
   - `KernelContentEntity` (extends Entity) — Wraps `KernelContent` with `IsContentType<TKernelContent>()`
   - `CyrenaFileManifest` — Manifest inside `.cyrena` archive with `Extension`, `Version`, `ImporterId`, `Properties`. JsonPropertyName annotations documented
   - `CyrenaKernelBuilder` — Per-chat kernel builder with `ChatConfiguration`, `KernelBuilder`, `FeatureOptions`, `Services`, `Plugins`
   - `CyrenaBuilder` — App-level DI builder with `AppDataDirectory`, `UserContentDirectory`, `ConversationsData`, `BuildActions`, `RunActions`, `Build()`
   - `CyrenaOptions` — Feature assemblies for runtime lookup
   - `EventPipeline` — Pub/sub event system with `InvokePipeline`, `ConfigurePipe`
   - `Entity`/`IEntity` — Base entity with `Id`
   - `ConnectionInfo` — LLM connection metadata record with `SupportImages`, `SupportFiles`
   - `FileAttachment` (extends Entity) — Persisted file attachment with `MimeType`, `Path`, `InternalName`, `Tools`, `Properties`. Factory method `From()`, `ToFileReference()`
   - `HistoryInclusionMode` — Enum: `All`, `LastTwo`, `LastTen`, `Instruct`. Controls context window size
   - `Prompt` — System prompt with `Id`, `Order`, `Content`
   - `QueuedInput` — Queued chat input with `Id`, `Role` (derived from `Message.Role`), `Message`
   - `ToolResult`/`ToolResult<T>` — Function call results. `ToolResult<T>` implements `ISuppressibleResult`
   - `ISuppressibleResult` — Interface with `Suppress()` to reduce context size after tool calls
4. **Options** — `ChatOptions` with `System`, `Assistant`, `User`, `Tool`, `LogInfo`, `LogSuccess`, `LogWarn`, `LogError`, `IncludeLogsInDisplay`, `MessagePersistRoles`
5. **Extension Methods** — `CyrenaBuilderExtensions`, `CyrenaKernelBuilderExtensions`, `ChatMessageServiceExtensions`, `ChatOptionsExtensions`, `KernelBuilderExtensions`, `KernelContentExtensions`, `Resources`
6. **Usage for Extension Developers** — 11-point summary including `ISuppressibleResult`, `ICyrenaFileExporter`/`ICyrenaFileImporter`, and `HistoryInclusionMode`

**Key Documentation Points:**
- Target Framework: .NET 10.0
- Core Dependency: Microsoft.SemanticKernel
- Any extension or plugin for Cyréna must reference this package
- `ICyrenaFileImporter` must be registered as a global singleton
- `HistoryInclusionMode` controls how much chat history is sent to the AI

**Template Notes:**
- All `<pre>` tags use `ngNonBindable` to prevent Angular from parsing `{` and `}` in C# code blocks as ICU message syntax.
- `{` and `}` characters in code blocks are HTML-escaped as `{` and `}`.
- `<` and `>` in generic type parameters are HTML-escaped as `<` and `>`.

**Styling:** Pure Bootstrap CSS. Uses `bg-dark text-light` on `<pre>` elements for code blocks. No custom component CSS — `cyrena-core.component.css` is empty.

**Change Detection:** `OnPush`

**No inputs or outputs.** This is a static documentation page.
